biotools.summary: scStateDynamics is a computational method for deciphering drug-responsive tumor cell state dynamics by modeling single-cell level expression changes. It infers cell state dynamics and identifies common drug effects by modeling gene expression changes and has been validated on simulated and lineage tracing data.
